name: VRChat
notes: Game will not launch due to anti-cheat / Lepton compatibility issues.

name: Outer Wilds
notes: Standalone play is unsupported on Quest 2: rendering can freeze, and loading a save exhausts memory with the full SteamVR interface. [Investigation notes](docs/outer-wilds-investigation.md).

name: It gets so lonely here
notes: Story, Quest controller input and music tested on Quest 2 with native ARM64 Ren'Py and Adreno GPU rendering.

name: Silly Polly Beast
notes: Standalone launch is unreliable on Quest 2: startup hangs or closes during scene loading.

name: Garden of Witches
notes: Local gameplay, picture, Quest gamepad controls and music confirmed on Quest 2. Startup is slow.

name: Z.A.T.O. // I Love the World and Everything In It
notes: Story, Quest controller input and music work with native ARM64 Ren'Py and Adreno GPU rendering. Menus and transitions remain slow.

name: Standable Full Body Estimation
notes: Supported locally. Tracker startup, settings, single dock icon and closing settings while trackers remain active confirmed on Quest 2. [Setup and limitations](docs/standable.md).

name: Sonic Mania
notes: Installation gets stuck on the SteamOS loading screen and does not complete. May require additional FEX/Proton configuration. [Issue #30](https://github.com/amichyrpi/stearlight/issues/30).
